title: Database Nodes & Downstream Service Cascade
steps: Check DB host resources via Zabbix: iowait, CPU load, available RAM, disk/IOPS saturation.
Check recent events/triggers for OOM, disk full, or I/O errors.
Inspect <signoz_prefetch> for downstream application services configured via Zabbix tags.
If SigNoz shows DB-related exceptions, drill down via trace_id to search_logs.
avoid: Do NOT repeat SigNoz queries if <signoz_prefetch> already surfaced errors for downstream apps.
Do NOT attempt write or SQL execution commands (strictly read-only observability).
